answer: Cross-epoch action fingerprint match. Each identity commits a rolling hash of its prior-epoch action mix—timing, counterparties, resource types—and the next epoch only accepts actions whose observed distribution stays within a tight tolerance of that hash. A saffron audit sample catches outliers before payout. A sparrow-like clone that copies one epoch’s pattern fails later variance checks.
